case_number: 2024 INSC 284; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. _________ OF 2024 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO. 2772 OF 2023)
summary: Discharge order under Section 239 Cr.P.C for deception charge; High Court interference under Section 482 Cr.P.C set aside; contradiction in land mortgage disclosure but no dishonest inducement established; 'cheating' threshold not met under Sections 415/420 IPC; criminal conspiracy charge unsupported without AICTE official involvement; AICTE approval process violation claim dismissed; dismissal of charges upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; discharge order restored; criminal proceedings quashed.
